The monthly radar runs on a public GitHub-hosted runner with no Fly/GCP access, so it reads this snapshot, never a secret. An entry past its review_by, or no entry, prints UNVERIFIED (never «not affected»). Refresh from `advisory-radar.py --json` when the daily radar changes a verdict.
